```
['create a RollingEnv instance with configurable tactile resolution and visualization options', 'run the simulate method to roll a ball to a goal location using PD control', 'create a Camera instance and call get_image to capture RGB and depth images from PyBullet', 'test the pose_estimation method to estimate ball location from tactile color and depth data', 'run the controller_Kx method to compute velocity from state goal and control gain matrix']
```

